thread:
julia: FYI while walking a new hire through the voice sample I hit two issues: the curl snippet in README uses OLD_API_KEY env var and the example curl URL points to /examples/stream which 404s.
sam: ugh, classic copy/paste drift. can you paste the exact curl?
julia: ```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OLD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/examples/stream \n  -d '{"text":"hello"}'
```
nate: that AUTH var name changed to REDWOOD_API_KEY ages ago. also base URL is `api.redwood-inference.com` now.
mia: thanks for catching. small followups: the README JS snippet still shows `import { client } from '@redwood/inference'` (wrong package) and the retry example shows a `maxRetries` param but no mention of jitter/backoff. new JS SDK uses exponential backoff with jitter=true by default. we should avoid implying parity unless we specify behavior per SDK.
julia: sounds like three fixes: update curl sample (env + url), correct JS import to `@redwood-inference/sdk`, and add a short note about retry/backoff defaults per SDK.
sam: also noticed package.json for sample lists `node-fetch@2` which breaks in node 20 ESM projects. switch to `undici` + add "type":"module"` to package.json in sample.
nate: can one of you open the PR? might be a quick docs change plus sample package bump.
mia: i'll do it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4295 title: "chore(samples): fix curl env var + imports + note on retry defaults". added a tiny README test in .github/workflows/samples-smoke.yml that runs `npm ci && node ./examples/voice/index.mjs` as a non-blocking check.
docs-bot: PR opened by mia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4295 :rocket:
julia: sweet. can we also add a CONTRIBUTING checklist item: "verify curl/cli examples, env var names, and package imports" so this doesn't regress?
mia: added a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING.md in the PR.
sam: going to add a short issue to track SDK retry parity docs so product docs can include a table of behavior per client (js/python/go). filed issue #1012.
nate: OK will triage into next sprint. thanks for the quick turnaround.
julia: merging once CI is green. thanks team :white_check_mark:
